appearance.subtle: Their shoulder blades stand out much too far.
appearance.obvious: Folded wings sit against their back, ribbed and leathery, twitching when they are startled.
appearance.extreme: They have wings that fill the room when they open, dark and veined and easily twice their height. Everyone has stopped talking.

description: Wings. Actual wings, grown from your shoulder blades, ribbed and enormous. Whether they will ever carry you is a question the Wildblood argue about.
drawbacks: No coat, no pack, no torso armour
name: Wings
